Our Mission

Sustainabilitywithout compromise.

We exist to eliminate single use plastic and the long haul transport of bottled water, one property at a time. By sourcing and bottling locally in reusable packaging, hotels cut their footprint while elevating the guest experience. A win for properties, guests, and the planet.

The Technology

An advanced 11 steppurification system.

Made in Canada and food and drug certified, our system pairs reverse osmosis and UV sterilization with alkaline enhancement to deliver clean, great tasting water at pH 8.0 and above, then filled, capped, and labeled on automated Canadian lines, on site, to remove transport emissions.

The Partnership

More than a program.A partnership.

A turnkey service model built to integrate with your operations while maximizing environmental impact.

01

Weekly Order Requirement

Right sized, recurring orders reduce over storage. Annual agreements support custom bottle labels, consistent supply, and pricing.

02

Direct Department Delivery in Crates

No cardboard, no plastic wrap. Bottles arrive in reusable crates, delivered straight to the department that needs them.

03

ESG Report with Every Invoice

See exactly how many plastic bottles you have saved, ready for your sustainability goals and reporting.

04

Aluminum Bottles for Active Areas

Food grade aluminum for pool and fitness zones where glass is not suitable, with no loss of sustainability.

24/7 support. Hospitality runs around the clock, and so do we. Urgent delivery is available any time you need it.
